description:
The Gnargo Trishaw is a three-wheel electric passenger bike for Cycling Without Age chapters, senior living communities and families. Built in the USA with stateside support, it brings passengers and pilots together for shared rides.

A removable front bench seats up to two passengers side by side. The integrated folding ramp makes entry easier, and removing the bench opens space for one wheelchair user with the optional Q'Straint Wheelchair Securement System installed.

An electric trishaw for community rides

Electric pedal assistance supports the pilot, while front passenger seating makes conversation part of the ride. Explore the specifications below to assess passenger access, dimensions and equipment for your program.

Contact Gnargo to discuss your chapter or community's trishaw needs.

components.description: TEKTRO Auriga Twin+ hydraulic disc brake system; • Twin-caliper system operating both front wheels; • 4-piston forged aluminum calipers; • 2.3 mm brake rotors; • Integrated parking-lock mechanism
TEKTRO Auriga+ hydraulic disc brake; • Single 4-piston forged aluminum caliper; • 2.3 mm brake rotor; • Four-finger brake lever; • Integrated parking-lock mechanism
Independent parking-lock functionality on both front and rear brake levers allows the front and rear braking systems to be locked while the Trishaw is stationary.
3X3 NINE internal gear hub (9-speed); Gates Carbon Belt Drive
Bosch 800 Wh removable rechargeable battery
Bosch Purion 200
3x3 Wireless Shifter

Schwalbe Motion Super Moto-X; • High-volume cargo/e-bike tire; • Double Defense puncture protection; • Reinforced for high-load applications; • E-50 rated; • Designed for cargo bikes and e-bikes operating on pavement and light terrain
A forward-facing padded bench carries up to two passengers side by side, providing an open view of the surroundings and making conversation with the pilot and other riders easy throughout the ride.

Two front wheels support the passenger compartment while a single driven rear wheel provides a familiar cycling experience for the pilot. The purpose-built chassis provides predictable handling at the low speeds typical of community rides.
A storage compartment beneath the passenger bench provides space for helmets and other ride essentials without adding to the Trishaw's footprint.
Up to two passengers seated side by side on the removable front bench
One wheelchair user with the passenger bench removed and optional Q'Straint Wheelchair Securement System installed
The front gate folds down to create an integrated access ramp. When raised, the gate locks into position and also functions as a handrail around the passenger compartment.
The padded two-passenger bench can be removed to provide an open compartment for wheelchair or cargo use.

Optional Q'Straint Wheelchair Securement System provides securement for one wheelchair and includes:; • Four retractors for four-point wheelchair securement; • One passenger lap belt; • Integrated L-track mounting points built into the Trishaw chassis for quick installation and removal of the securement system
The integrated ramp also provides easier entry and exit for passengers who have difficulty stepping into a conventional cycle passenger compartment.
Three-wheel front-load cycle with two front wheels supporting the passenger compartment and one driven rear wheel beneath the pilot
Fabricated and assembled in Bentonville, Arkansas
Designed primarily for low-speed operation on community routes, campuses, greenways, neighborhood streets, and similar environments.
Two 20" front wheels; One 20" driven rear wheel
Three Heavy-duty 20" wheels hand-built by Velocity USA using Clydesdale rims
